name: Topographic illumination and horizon-shadow verification
purpose: Verify facet/ray occlusion and terrain horizon classification independently of observational scoring.
production_capability: Triangulated-surface ray tracing, terrain shadow attributes, and uniform apparent-disc Earth-eclipse overlap.
configuration: Deterministic horizontal facet and vertical-ridge fixture; 1 micrometre ray-origin offset declared by the fixture.
independent_reference: Closed-form line/plane intersection and facet-normal sign.
frame_time_convention: One declared lunar body-fixed frame and fixed Sun vector/epoch.
procedure: Call the production BVH ray service for overhead, single-ridge, back-facing, and exact ridge-distance cases; call the production apparent-disc overlap kernel for disjoint, total, contained, and partial equal-radius circles.
acceptance_criteria: All three terrain classifications exact, original ridge intersection distance within 1e-14 relative, and every closed-form circle-overlap branch within 1e-14 relative. Additional lunar-coordinate translation/ray-direction-rescaling fixtures preserve hit distance within 1e-9 relative; this separate floating-point cancellation check does not relax the original fixtures.
expected_pass_result: Production terrain shadowing is geometrically correct and independently classified.
data_hashes: Analytical geometry uses no observations; actual furnished SPICE dependencies for moving-surface-transaction are hashed in U09/kernel_hashes.json. I15 owns independent D02 scoring.
status_semantics: PASS verifies the production terrain-ray kernel only; it is not D02 observational validation or linked I15 wiring.
shared_vertex_regression: Every twentieth vertex of a lunar-radius production icosphere must be hit by its centre-to-vertex radial ray. Zero misses required. The oracle is closed-surface vertex membership, not a frozen production output.

moving_surface_transaction_extension.scope: Local production geometry/frame transaction only; no observational or I14 qualification
moving_surface_transaction_extension.fixture: Closed1000m octahedron, actual furnished SPICE at2009-01-24T00:00:00,1000s physical birth offset, two distinct face previews and one accepted selected normal
moving_surface_transaction_extension.oracles: Exact plane crossing at5s; octahedron normal(1,1,1)/sqrt(3); inverse state-transform identity; SOURCE-BEGIN rotation with zero lower-left derivative; legacy matrix byte preservation
moving_surface_transaction_extension.count_criterion: Zero increments or accepted frame from previews; exactly one increment from the actual selected-frame commit
moving_surface_transaction_extension.dependency_semantics: SPICE-enabled producer required for this added mode; unavailable SPICE is SKIPPED with earlier geometry-mode artifacts retained

psd_geometry_wiring_extension.scope: Existing U09 direct illumination geometry applied through the actual shared-core PSD kernel; deterministic local fixtures, never source-strength validation or observations
psd_geometry_wiring_extension.law: physical atoms times compiled effective cross section [m2] times compiled 1-AU photon flux [m^-2 s^-1] times unabsorbed projected direct-photon 1-AU factor
psd_geometry_wiring_extension.configuration: 2-by-4 logical unit-radius sphere, 64 physical Na atoms in one element, existing positive compiled Na PSD coefficients, production 32-by-128 finite-disc grid
oracles: NULL hook retains exact legacy expression and cached-total behavior
full perpendicular flux, half central incidence, backface zero
actual-point inverse-square dilution at twice distance
opaque Earth totality and production BVH ridge umbra
exact zero stock skips geometry callback
live total/current-stock sum and per-area ceiling/diagnostic
total refresh preserves stock and pending deposit/release counters
psd_geometry_wiring_extension.failure_probe: psd-illumination-invalid must terminate through the AMPS finite/nonnegative factor diagnostic; run separately as expected-error infrastructure coverage
psd_geometry_wiring_extension.unavailable: SKIPPED when the compiled build lacks positive Na PSD coefficients; source coefficients are never changed by this fixture
psd_geometry_wiring_extension.limits: Does not establish source strength, actual epoch registration, CDF/finite-hazard linked transport, M1 convergence or I15/I19 qualification

finite_disc_extension.scope: Uniform-radiance projected-disc quadrature; production BVH and correlated opaque-Earth masks; deterministic numerical verification only
finite_disc_extension.grid: Explicit 32x128 coarse and 256x512 fine analytical horizon; no default scientific ray resolution
finite_disc_extension.trend: fine analytical horizon error smaller than coarse
cases: occurrence distinct from mean disc area
BVH ridge half-disc penumbra and umbra
finite_disc_extension.qualification_limit: finite ray grids can miss arbitrarily thin visible slivers; D02 use requires independent angular/temporal resolution qualification and exact authoritative sampling metadata

gas_photon_visibility_extension.scope: U09 analytical geometry only; no I21 product kinetics or observation validation
gas_photon_visibility_extension.law: Integral of uniform radiance over jointly visible solid angle divided by full-disc solid angle; no facet cosine or surface albedo
gas_photon_visibility_extension.fixture: Analytical Sun radius500m at1000m; concentric opaque Earth radius2.5m at10m; 32x128 coarse and512x128 fine; true gas-point origin
gas_photon_visibility_extension.refinement: fine absolute error smaller than coarse
negative_controls: nonzero surface offset rejected in volume mode
